scope: Independent source and runtime review of exact question admission, existing retrieval/controller gates, private visitor ownership, session commit and replay, and complete-unit verified SSE UI wiring. This is not a hosted build or deployment acceptance.

original_source.method: Independent original PDF text inspection with PyMuPDF, separate from retrieval results and planner assertions.

GEN003.source_scope: Convex mirror view makes viewed objects appear smaller and farther away than a flat mirror, with care when judging distance.
approved_additional_question_scopes: Why do vehicles look farther in my mirrors?
Do vehicles in mirrors look smaller and farther away?
GEN003.assessment: Both ask about apparent vehicles or objects in mirrors. Neither asks whether the mirror itself is smaller or farther away. Exact approved canonical response retains the distance caution. The why-question receives a slightly awkward opening Yes, but its complete canonical explanation answers the requested source-backed scope.

GEN007.source_scope: Fuel specification is unleaded gasoline with ethanol content up to E20.
GEN007.assessment: The four permission questions are supported by the up-to-E20 specification. The complete unchanged canonical response retains unleaded gasoline and explicitly does not approve fuel above E20.

closed_findings.prior_issue: Bag-of-words admission affirmed different subjects and relations with a canonical Yes response.
closed_findings.resolution: An ordered Unicode proposition key is now mandatory before term or relevance checks. Negation, clauses, comparison symbols and all other punctuation except a single trailing question mark remain significant. Only explicit spelling/fuel-name substitutions and versioned reviewed paraphrases are admitted.
independent_negative_probes: Are mirrors farther away than vehicles?
Do smaller mirrors look farther away?
Can I not use E20 fuel?
Can I use E20 fuel? followed by an additional Chinese-script repair clause
closed_findings.result: All six returned UNSUPPORTED even with synthetic retrieved evidence for GEN003 and GEN007. All six approved additional question scopes returned SUPPORTED with PDF pages 13 or 18 respectively.

closed_findings.prior_issue: Session quota could be discovered only after retrieval work.
closed_findings.resolution: The 20-turn limit is checked before retrieval and also enforced at atomic commit. Independent targeted probe confirmed no extra retrieval at the limit.

closed_findings.prior_issue: Idle-expired session blocked replay of a completed operation still inside operation retention.
closed_findings.resolution: Operation replay occurs before session idle validation and remains owner- and payload-bound.

closed_findings.prior_issue: Known feedback conflicts could leave an operation indefinitely pending.
closed_findings.resolution: Choice validation precedes reservation; known post-reservation conflicts are terminal failures, and the client clears pending operation state on terminal responses. Uncertain commit failures remain recoverable.

runtime_assessment: Raw question text reaches the existing hybrid retriever unchanged; no answer provider is called, no mandatory symptom wizard is introduced, and selection examines the registry rather than the initial30 subset.

Retrieved relevance and term coverage are only ranking or exclusion signals. Selection requires an exact bound canonical proposition or one of the six reviewed paraphrases, a direct action-evidence hit, singleton controller eligibility and the original source/dependency/warning/citation gates.
Question scope reads verify bound planner file hashes. Technical output remains exact reviewed canonical wording through ArmAComposer and the internal saved_view provenance gate.

Private authenticated UI principal produces the stable signed visitor capability. Backend owner includes the verified backend principal and visitor identity. Backend identity tokens refresh per request; visitor signing secret stays server-side.

Session version, parent head, preserved immutable attempt prefix, scope locks, quota, snapshot view and operation completion are committed together under existing transaction/CAS semantics. Retention stays fixed at 24 hours, with idle activity bounded by that fixed expiry and snapshots confined to arm_a_session_versions.

Completed operation replay preserves saved output without retrieval or generation reruns. Complete technical units are streamed only after gates and persistence; SSE validation rejects malformed, duplicated, mismatched or incomplete final output.

validation.command: python -m unittest cloud.arm_a.test_question_wiring rider_ui.tests.test_client rider_ui.tests.test_verified_sse rider_ui.tests.test_identity -v
validation.environment: Default Python with existing isolated build/arm-a-test-dependencies on PYTHONPATH; no global package installation.
validation.additional_probes: Six approved paraphrase source/page probes and six independent negative scope probes, plus Unicode and slash-symbol proposition inequality probes.

limitations_and_remaining_gates: Arbitrary input is accepted, but answer admission is intentionally limited to ordered bound canonical questions and six reviewed additional scopes. Unmatched paraphrases abstain; this review does not establish broad semantic question coverage or retrieval calibration.
The PASS verdict requires private IAM on both UI and backend. Anonymous or public UI identity, abuse controls and public release are outside this reviewed scope.

Frozen build contexts, exact Docker/build recipe and full hosted suite closure must be reviewed before deployment. This report does not approve a deployment or assert live acceptance of this new question/UI runtime.
Public PDF/excerpt/image delivery, general multimodal interpretation, and expanded adaptive source transitions remain outside this verdict.
Existing live initial API acceptance does not prove the newly wired question/UI path, physical TTL deletion timing or p95 performance.
Any changed bound runtime or source bytes require a new scoped independent review/version.
